issue_title: The uv attribute is not well handled in ply exporter
issue_body:
Hi, thanks for the great library.

An issue is found when exporting a mesh to ply. When the `mesh.visual.uv` is `None`, direct access to `mesh.visual.uv[:, 0]` and `mesh.visual.uv[:, 1]` will raise an error.

https://github.com/mikedh/trimesh/blob/021af1fedb3c6cff0e42cba9eed140eea7f819e3/trimesh/exchange/ply.py#L265-L271

I think only using the `hasattr` to check the existence of attributes is not enough, additional not-None checks should be considered, since other exporters have handled this correctly as following.

https://github.com/mikedh/trimesh/blob/021af1fedb3c6cff0e42cba9eed140eea7f819e3/trimesh/exchange/obj.py#L887-L889
